headline: Up Your Arsenal adds six native NTSC-U frontend routines
summary: Six native NTSC-U routines land in #1, covering frontend state, timers, callbacks and dialog handling across eight program placements. The NTSC-U progress update reports 8.38% matched code and 5,677 of 16,222 functions. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. PAL v1.00 is measured separately and remains at 8.72% matched code with 5,807 of 16,164 functions.
